newsitem.title: USA: Louisiana Bond Commission approves 16 issues.
newsitem.headline: Louisiana Bond Commission approves 16 issues.

text.p: Louisiana Bond Commission gave final approval Thursday to 16 state and local government bond issues totalling $231.4461 million.
--$34 million of Port of New Orleans Industrial Development Revneune Refunding Bonds, to refund 1982 bonds issued for Contentinal Grain Co.
--$27 million South Louisiana Port Commission port facilities refunding revenue bonds to refund 1981 bonds issued for the Occidental Petroleum Corp.
--$26 million of Louisiana Public Facilities Authority advance funding notes, to provide low cost financing for short term funding needs of local school boards.
--$25 million of East Baton Rouge Mortgage Finance Authority single family mortgage revenue bonds and $15.575 million of single family mortgage revenue refunding bonds.
--$19.5 million Parish of St. James pollution control facilities refunding revenue bonds, to refund 1981 bonds issued for Occidental Petroleum.
--$15 million of Calcasieu Parish Public Trust Authority qualified mortgage credit certificates to provide loans for first-time home buyers.
--$12 million of Iberia Parish Hospital Service District No. 1 hospital revenue bonds.
--$11 million of Orleans Levee District levee improvement refunding bonds to refud the remainder of its 1987 series, and $3.5 million of Orleans Levee District public improvement bonds.
--$10 million of Lafourche Parish Water District No 1 water revenue bonds.
--$10 million Town of Delhi industrial development refunding revenue bonds, to refund 1982 bonds issued for the Tifton Aluminun Co
--$8 million St. Tammany Parish Hospital Service District 2 hospital revenue bonds for renovations and upgrades at Slidell Memorial Hospital and Medical Center.
--$7 million of St John the Baptist Parish sales tax district public improvement refunding bonds, to refund a 1990 series of public improvement bonds.
--$5.6 million of Acadia Parish Police Jury sales tax road bonds.
--$72,000 of Evangeline Parish Ward Four water district revenue bonds.
--$541,000 of Town of Columbia sewer revenue bonds.
